name: Love Me, Love My Buffalo
original_name: เลดี้ทุ่งกระบือบาล
overview: A young district chief, Jomthap, defies his billionaire mother’s demands to inherit the family empire, choosing instead to serve a rural community. When an unintended marriage to Pichaya, a fierce village woman devoted to her land and buffaloes, entangles him further, he is drawn into a high-stakes battle over power, trust, and the village’s future.
